title: Picking a Steam capsule from in-game shots only: which of these 4 would you click?
author: Chaibi_Alaa
selftext:
BlockRise is a city tycoon: you buy plots, open shops and fight rivals for the street. The buildings are AI-generated models, like in our earlier posts here; these four are straight in-game shots with the logo on top, no generated or painted key art.

  
A1 / A2: street level, first shops under construction, the city behind.

B1 / B2: top-down on a crossroads, plots and buildings.

  
Which one would you click at small size in a Steam list, and why? And for those who shipped: did an in-game capsule hold up, or did you end up commissioning key art?

comments.author: zreakz
comments.body: Tbh none of them look great. I know it’s hard with an RTS having a see all pov, but you really need to have something specific to focus on that’s clear to see.

comments.author: Prior-Meeting1645
comments.body: Definitely one of the top 2 not the bottom 2 for me
